blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas men’s team vented its ire on Uzbekistan, 25-19, 25-15, 23-25, 25-17, to bag its first win in the Asian Games men’s volleyball on Friday at Park Arena Komaki. Team captain Bryan Bagunas erupted for 26 points, helping Alas Pilipinas snap their four-game skid in the tournament to advance to the 13th-place match against Kyrgyzstan on Saturday afternoon. Bagunas returned to full action after playing sparingly in their 23-25, 26-24, 22-25, 21-25 loss to Indonesia less than 24 hours ago. Amid struggles over lack of […]...
